page: Microsoft Azure M128ds_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv2 family. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the server includes a bundled 4194 GB local SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not feature any integrated GPUs, making it strictly a CPU-bound and memory-bound resource. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Given its massive memory capacity and high core count, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring dense memory footprints without the overhead of physical hardware maintenance. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and heavy data-processing pipelines that demand substantial RAM and dedicated compute resources.
